column2: Easy water, traveller, but keep your eyes open to the south-south-east. A bear and her cubs roam about sixty-five paces off that way, and farther on, about a hundred paces more, a Tree Mother lives in the woods. Stay clear of both.
The Dwemer Ruin, traveller? Easy enough. Walk south-east from here, about a hundred and fifty paces, and you are standing in it.

Alten Merihall, traveller? Walk south-east about a hundred and twenty paces, until the Dwemer Ruin is on your left, and then keep south-east about two hundred and ninety paces more. Alten Merihall is there, and the money with it. If you would rather go by water, I can take you.
Lilmoth Dock, traveller? Walk west about a hundred and twenty paces, until the big ship is on your left, and then climb west about three hundred paces more. The dock is there.
Easy water, my friend! Sit by me a while. There is room on the landing. I chose Soulrest over Lilmoth Dock because there is no licence to be shown here. Now I have good company besides.
Easy water, traveller. This is Soulrest, and I run a boat from the landing here. Where are you going, and do you need a boat to get there?
Soulrest is where the boats tie up, traveller. Mine is one of them. A large ship lies west of here, about eighty paces to the west-south-west, with a door aboard if you want to look inside.

Lilmoth fell, traveller. The outside traders went elsewhere after that. Alten Merihall's merchants have taken much of the bay's trade since then. That is where the money is now. I would carry you there gladly.
Easy water, traveller. Heavy-Rope leads the crew on Soulrest's dock, and they want to end their season early, but the broker who hires them out will not let them.
I am Seeks-The-Channel, and I run a boat out of Soulrest, east of Lilmoth Dock. I wait here at the head of the landing between fares. I chose this place because no licence is asked for here.
